insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Schedule of Coverage)

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: We will pay for Medical Expenses incurred and admissible under Section B-I-1,up to additional Sum Insured equivalent to Basic Sum Insured... Claim under this Cover is admissible only when total of Basic Sum Insuredis completely utilized.
great.reference: Section B, III Optional Covers, 9. Major Illness Hospitalization Expenses (around page 16)
great.explanation: You get an extra Sum Insured equal to your Basic Sum Insured for major illnesses, usable only after your base Sum Insured is fully used in the policy year. This gives you additional financial protection beyond the base limit.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section C, 1.I Waiting Periods, i) Pre-existing Diseases – Code – Excl01 (around page 19)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 48 months of continuous coverage. This waiting period is standard and acceptable in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.
good.reference: Section C, 1.I Waiting Periods, ii) Specified Disease/Procedure waiting period – Code – Excl02 (around page 19)
good.explanation: Listed conditions and surgeries are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which aligns with industry norms.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.reference: Section C, 1.I Waiting Periods, iii) 30-day waiting period – Code – Excl03 (around page 20)
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days except for accidents, which is a common waiting period in health insurance.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay for the Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred during the 60 days immediately before Hospitalization
good.reference: Section B, I Hospitalization Cover, 4. Pre-hospitalization cover (around page 10)
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, providing good support for related treatment costs.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay for the Post-HospitalizationMedical Expenses incurred upto180 days from the date Insured Person is discharged from Hospital
good.reference: Section B, I Hospitalization Cover, 5. Post-Hospitalization cover (around page 10)
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered, which helps with recovery costs.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: On each Renewal of the Policy with Us, We will apply 5% of Basic Sum Insured... Cumulative Bonus will be reduced at the same rate as accrued in the event of admissible Claim... Cumulative Bonus can be accumulated upto 50% of Basic Sum Insured.
good.reference: Section B, II Renewal Benefits, 2. Cumulative Bonus (around page 11)
good.explanation: Your Sum Insured increases by 5% each claim-free renewal up to 50%, but reduces proportionally if you claim. This rewards claim-free years with higher coverage.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: Not found in provided policy wording excerpt.
bad.reference: Document review: Section B Benefits & Optional Covers (no restore/reinstatement/restoration clause found).
bad.explanation: Sum Insured is not replenished after a claim unless you buy a separate optional benefit. This means you lose coverage amount after a claim.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-Medical expenses such as Food charges... laundry charges, attendant charges... Full list of Non-Medical expenses is attached... Annexure I - List of Non-Medical Expenses ... (includes) GLOVES ... NEBULISATION KIT ... ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED...
bad.reference: Section C, 2.II Specific Permanent Exclusions, xii) Non-Medical expenses (around page 21) and Annexure I lists (around pages 32-34)
bad.explanation: Consumables and non-medical items like gloves and kits are excluded unless you buy an add-on cover, meaning you may pay out-of-pocket for these common items.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Insured Person shall bear specified percentage of admissible Claim amount under each and every Claim If Co-payment is applicable
bad.reference: Section B, I Hospitalization Cover (appears repeatedly, around pages 10-11)
bad.explanation: Co-pay applies if specified but the default percentage is not stated. It may vary by premium tier or optional cover, so confirm from your Policy Schedule.

unclear.explanation: The default room rent entitlement is not clearly stated; only an optional capped room rent is mentioned. Check your Policy Schedule for your actual room rent limit.
